heading: FAQ
supportIntro: Can’t find the answer you need? Drop us a line.

items.question: How do I get access?
items.answer: The pilot is invitation-only. Open your invitation email to get started. Already have access? Sign in.

items.question: Which AI chats can I use?
items.answer: Start with the setup guides for ChatGPT and Hermes. For other MCP clients, check their connection requirements before getting started.

items.question: What happens to my account details?
items.answer: The service stores your AimHarder credentials encrypted and can recover them to authenticate. Your AI chat does not receive them.

items.question: Can I disconnect later?
items.answer: Yes. You can disconnect each AI client independently. Disconnecting AimHarder and deleting your AIHarder account are separate actions.

items.question: Is this an official AimHarder service?
items.answer: No. AIHarder is an independent project and is not affiliated with AimHarder.
